section.title: Parabolas, ellipses, and hyperbolas
section.p: Lines and circles are not the only curves that appear in calculus. Parabolas are the basic graphs of quadratic functions. Ellipses appear in planetary motion and optimization. Hyperbolas appear in reciprocal functions, asymptotes, and polar coordinates.
These curves are called conic sections, or simply conics, because they can be obtained by slicing a cone with a plane. For our purposes, the most important skill is algebraic recognition.
